description: seamreg: record what each seamreg agent really costs during a paid run, and refuse a start that would pass the run's ceiling. Both do nothing outside an open run.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/seams/spend.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src" python3 -m seams.spend pre-tool-use || true
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/seams/spend.py"; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src" python3 -m seams.spend subagent-stop || true
